notes: The page describes, in the author’s formulation, automorphisms à lacets of the indicated completed fundamental group that commute with σ₀ and commute externally with ρ. It parameterizes their images of l₁ and l∞ by g₁ and p, states two boxed conditions on h₁ and the exponents β and γ, and defines h₁ = σ₀(g₁)^{-1}g₁. These are transcribed claims, not independently established results in this report.

The upper-right marginal note supplies the image of l₀ and names its conjugating element g₀. The short left note reads et barred-m pas u!, with barred m identified as the abbreviation même. The longer left note states On doit en fait avoir followed by the unresolved β/γ comparison and an instruction to pass to the abelianization. The wording On doit en fait avoir is retained; no additional authorial question mark or explicit doubt phrase was confidently recovered.

The author rewrites the second relation and substitutes it in the first to obtain (1′). In the final NB paragraph he changes the representative g₁ to g₁l₁^μ and records the corresponding h₁′. The heavily corrected last display and underlined equality lead to the surviving assertion γ′ = γ, with a cancelled additive term, and the final β′ = β. The main reader performed the two local algebraic checks described below; the difficult final representative-change formula was not thereby resolved.

The expected transformation of the final conjugating term motivated attention to the small ρ superscript, but was not used to supply or erase any symbol. The ink permits a cancelled −1 as well as live superscript alternatives. The main reader retained uncertainty in this superscript and the overwritten terms; the touching parentheses are retained at medium confidence. Before (2)_2, à versus colon remains expressly doubtful.

C’s four explicit cancelled items in the final display and closing equalities have all been individually inspected: underlying h₁, the factor proposed as l₁^μ, the term proposed as +2μ or +μ, and underlying β. Their doubts remain because not every struck letter is plain. The à lacets insertion is above the first line and attaches after autom. Two further possible cancellation sites are recorded: the opening overwritten word and the final ρ exponent. A clear omitted cancellation stands before β in the unboxed rewritten relation.

The manuscript page number is 2. No date was found. The reference (2)₂ and the unusual phrase remplacé en are preserved as written. No clear mathematical authorial slip is asserted solely from the transcription. No other page, external publication, OCR, or recognition software was used.

Local algebra check of the rewrite: put A = h₁ l₁^(−γ) ρ⁻¹(h₁). Equation (2) has ρ(h₁) l∞^(−γ) A = l₀^β; multiplying on the left by l∞^γ ρ(h₁)⁻¹ gives A = l∞^γ ρ(h₁)⁻¹ l₀^β, in that order. In int(A)(l₀^p), the terminal l₀^β commutes with l₀^p and therefore disappears from the conjugation. This verifies the displayed passage to (1′) locally. It does not identify the overwritten exponent or prove any surrounding characterization of automorphisms.

Local abelianization check of the margin: write e₀+e₁+e∞=0, with ρ cycling these three classes. The operator 1+ρ+ρ² is zero on this rank-two module. Abelianizing (2) gives −γ(e∞+e₁)=βe₀, hence γe₀=βe₀ and β=γ. Thus the expected statement is equality. The oblique comparison strokes themselves are still recorded as = versus ≠; the calculation is not used to erase that paleographical doubt.
